notes.title: DEVELOPER JOURNAL #3 - Sound Design
notes.content:
Welcome!
Last time in the Dev Journals, we discussed how I Hate This Place’s story originated from a comic book series of the same name created by Kyle Starks and Artyom Topilin. However, the game is much more than just the plot!

Today, we want to take you a little deeper into sound design - how we’re using it as more than just atmosphere. In I Hate This Place, silence isn’t simply golden — it can mean the difference between life and death.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/526847f29bb063c36f6433b85f4716dcfcbb1cc3.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/88ce940221704bad8531c1c2cb167cbabd3f9971.png"]The world of I Hate This Place is filled with a lot of nightmarish, otherworldly creatures from a rather eerie and distorted world.

But what might not be so clear is that many of these hulking monstrosities can barely see. Instead, they stalk their prey (you) by sound, so all your actions and movements need to be thought out. Every footstep, every gunshot, every clang of metal can give off your location.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/6854c87d229542dec44997bd56b851afdac6e434.gif"]

So whether you’re creeping through overgrown woods or navigating decrepit facilities, the surface beneath your sneakers matters. A slow, crouched shuffle across grass will likely be ignored. A careless stomp on broken glass, not so much.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/526847f29bb063c36f6433b85f4716dcfcbb1cc3.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/a75c7aa82b8ca1b1cc01f97134fa990eb15bced2.png"]

Just as sound can get you killed, it can also be used to your advantage and become your most useful weapon. With a bit of strategy and planning, you can lure monsters away from key areas or into your cleverly laid traps. Tossing an empty can down a hallway or into the underbrush might attract a nearby creature, giving you the opening you need to escape. Or you can herd enemies into one spot and proceed to throw a molotov right in the middle.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/d8caf3519a1626e0db98aa1eda56855ef5f98dc7.gif"]

Choose your battles wisely - many of the creatures you’ll encounter are brutal, and even more so when night falls. Going in guns blazing is doable, but maybe not always the right move.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/526847f29bb063c36f6433b85f4716dcfcbb1cc3.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/3238ebf6205e1eb86a18fb96231c74f1b692372e.png"]

To take the noise system in I Hate This Place further and make it more clever to players, we also made sound into a visual language, where noise is color-coded. It’s a unique visual system inspired to tie in with the game’s comic book art style. 

For example:

Green footsteps mean you’re quiet, crouched, moving slowly, minimizing risk

Yellow signals you’re walking at a normal pace and making moderate noise

Red means you’re running or being loud, and you’re a beacon for danger

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/1e22f84535eb6a892f006a7a5f2fecc2be8e6c67.gif"]

This color-coded feedback system doesn’t just apply to footsteps, though. Gunfire, thrown objects, even the howls and attacks of enemies all follow the same noise-visibility rules, helping you judge just how much noise all of your actions are creating.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/526847f29bb063c36f6433b85f4716dcfcbb1cc3.png"]

That’s all for now. Let us know if you would like us to continue sharing our journey with you through the Developer Journals! We would love to hear your thoughts in the comments 🙂

notes.title: DEVELOPER JOURNAL #1 - The Backstory
notes.content:
Hi there!
     I Hate This Place is a game that originated from a comic book series of the same name created by Kyle Starks and Artyom Topilin. That inspiration manifests itself in the game’s artwork, setting, characters, monsters and… story! 

     Many of you have asked where the original characters are, when chronologically does the game take place in the IHTP universe and where we are. So, we are writing our first Developer Journal to answer all your lore questions!


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeYZ9CpPv79fkcYUp1oc2InY8kcaRrFRJN8-1NhHZFx4mDdETZkez7H0xXc6v1IvYWiKPxDQQ1PID_isHmOpLm4cOaT54F0ov1bEmbGhyCl5FiYGCIrvwSLxjKxEGdN720q0kC5?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf0mOnO_vfmWCh8f793IBRDgUmw6zYAzFr4UvsvzPsk9gx8AIh2yOGH_ihmrb74eGt_ZArvS2G5YgnWxGWe3TvMp6CaGGv3n7Fe-vEX10JUUTNn0cEY4eGjf4ivyJkGTE9CUHLc0Q?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

     You may know the iconic duo of Gabby Rutherford and Trudy Durant from the original comics. However, we decided to take a different route and create our own characters in the same universe. In the game, you will meet Elena and Lou instead - childhood best friends bound together by their shared love for spooky stories.


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdDnL34SpvhDxQq8oWA-sv58P-FmAJQXr7WtVvpwDPFTJkKU-V7LcY_TMSWbEemVmtm43WMvO0lyhHx9eTpRLsSTd57Yc5RS8a89CXab1QKOPoYxpXianz7A0ZFGlSJm9ahJZ6nJg?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]     Elena is our fearless protagonist who, just like Gabby in the comics, needs to adapt very fast to the crazy circumstances happening around her in the forest. She has to gather food to survive, craft resources to fight monsters and, most importantly, find out if the mysterious vanishings near the ranch are really The Horned Man’s doing. Elena is no longer a child scared of what's happening on the ranch; after years of training and preparations she is ready to face her fears and confront The Horned Man.  

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcFM8Gk0SYPnk8r-KOupfIx1PczDHTDH4xRrB9Z77QaE5hEX0W_Bub38tKdEJA-xEi3GmnFg-wsGfr9XJtFDJM9tNJ6ZgC6lsJ9E7_9mY8ZRaFoRbmVM4n_x8HDqjByH-sioh_6?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcMcv5VLWMxSmRDjjKwOskarml_v0hhSypn_o36fDQb4sX8ykbeyRmNeL3oNZRgarVBYuaBQbX43VniKcrYCuOh_GeLIgJ2P6NcYZRvk0aJdJcaj2W2onG94K1sGyUdKmHha9TMqA?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

     With a different set of characters also comes some changes to the timeline. Set in the late 80s, the game's events unfold long before those depicted in the comic. We are visiting The Rutherford Ranch, well-known from Gabby and Trudy’s story – a mysterious place haunted by monsters, ghosts and The Horned Man - a creature lurking in the forests nearby. Elena is no stranger to this place: her mother, who has been missing for years, is a Rutherford (specifically, Aunt Marilyn’s sister - that’s another name that comic fans may recognize). 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeM39M4KF5rxYQe4cjZar2Q6m8mh1n7eMfVCKMr3YkdP8WmiBBGAYraq0fk4Djfj4ivWgdMn3daEqb9J0yw_OFqmhqbFlyAbE8xfd4RU_7HXcwWJiVVJ8nkBJCTYbx83GrmGr0H0A?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

    Players will have a chance to explore much more than just the ranch and the forest! We added some new places around the area. As you delve deeper into the forest, you will find many derelict mining shafts, mysterious bunkers and overall creepy areas that you would rather not stay the night in. But that part, you’ll have to explore yourself - we don’t want to spoil the experience of walking through the environment we created ;) 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcibQAUz3un1KRCQZZ9Iswb7iwPycF1ndcEez-R5_E8-nM0GEocTyNflnhcQQt0qKqhgMo6l6zxmhkBZ7sBdqeQdkfXG5x--bVMHR2KamSzxt4ZzKY3McQguktjtJ8WWXs-41BQ?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeyXGpWVOJ9Q6K8hTG0_7MrRCM1SI3WleSRkfPbEAacx90eDPOyKoxYVs9OT5iF4ZjghPm576Vwtui-knxwt47aUFKxmZK9AOwU1b0Pd5q18GgTF2oaoQp4CHzCCPMlUkr62eSPIg?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

    So far, we have covered how the characters and how the setting and time ties back to the I Hate This Place universe. But what about the backstory? We created a unique story in the universe with Elena and Lou in mind, as well as some interesting NPCs. The story begins when, after many years spent in the city, Elena renews contact with Lou, who lives close to The Rutherford Ranch, and visits this place again.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeyPJ1Ob7aDQ9GSMUu_kKoIQmi5G-hWhr2i-EW1zUdYRaZzHKKm--CqN8-n6T5JmL-TETY-85MNGV-OV-naw4cU_h5aGqoqhM3-Afuf-dVqLnCxzMn2Q2jqbUclho_v7rSNn9MI?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]   Before the beginning of the game, Lou convinces Elena to try to summon The Horned Man to discover if he is even real, but something goes wrong: Elena loses consciousness and wakes up without Lou. She then begins the search that becomes the main goal in the story. Will you be able to save her before it’s too late or will you fall prey to The Horned Man as well?

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd8hH-Wp92YoqaLiw9YdWRDV4R7ftWYyV9pFWBQTSf9JkW6oKx0SVyoV4coUjGfiuuaznSp-cuAHDIsb5pnudj0bBe6uYzu-ZfTaDHAL-2WqbvwADOlrqzLqO8fqMJK8p8DGmkvHg?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"]

That’s all for now. Let us know if you would like us to continue sharing our journey with you through the Developer Journals! We would love to hear your thoughts in the comments 🙂

notes.title: Play I Hate This Place Demo Now! 🥳
notes.content:
You asked, we delivered! 🥳

Starting today, you can play an early demo version of I Hate This Place as we are celebrating Polish games on Steam during the From Poland With Love event! 💥


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/31a56152928da8f499d9af1205a40ff895da76ee.png"]
If you don’t know anything about I Hate This Place yet, let's get you up to speed so you can enjoy the demo to its fullest potential:
a craft-based, isometric survival horror game with twisted monsters and warped reality

styled with bold comic art and an '80s horror vibe (inspired by the award-nominated comic book series with the same name by Kyle Starks and Artyom Topilin)

where stealth and combat go hand-in-hand as many of the twisted creatures in Rutherford Ranch hunt and stalk you by sound alone

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/e5bb37ebaabd3029dfc9b8744336660eb7d46d9b.gif"]
Got your blood pumping? Well, then head on over and download the demo now, where you will:
Get an early introduction to the game's story and premise by talking with the cultists and find mysterious clues and signs

Familiarize yourself with the comic books inspired sound design of the game with onomatopoeias and noise mechanic. Every footstep, every gunshot, every clang of metal can give off your location.

Fight enemies such as weird spiderlings, ''zombies'' and mutants with plethora of different weapons both melee and ranged. 

Craft and manage your resources to survive in the most f***ed-up forest you've ever experienced.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/f1d8c02df6b96181428464c15bb0cca4e3176c71.jpg"]
If you have any feedback, we’ve opened up a special Steam Forum thread exclusively for your thoughts and suggestions concerning the demo! 


Thank you so much for your support and we hope you enjoy this demo version of I Hate This Place!

notes.title: Play I Hate This Place at San Diego Comic-Con 2025! 💥
notes.content:
Hi everybody! 👋After your very warm reception of I Hate This Place at BitSummit 2025, we are gearing up to meet you in San Diego for this year's Comic Con! 💥💥💥
SDCC is dedicated to creating the general public’s awareness of and appreciation for comics, which is also important to us. Our game I Hate This Place is inspired by the comic by the same name by Artyom Topilin & Kyle Starks, so we just had to join in on the fun in San Diego.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/3e64f7e7a95d182e7dd7b95eb4b429d9ba77e457.png"]
You can play I Hate This Place there early starting July 24th, so come and get a taste of this isometric horror-survival title straight from HELL 🔥 
 If you are interested, check us out at Restart Gaming Lounge - SDCC's largest official gaming destination ever. Below you can find a very useful map for locating us during the event 👇
